purpose: A linked FiveM server script and Discord bot command suite for managing personal vehicle ownership, vehicle imports, and driver permissions through a shared SQL database. The system ensures that only the assigned owner or approved whitelisted players can drive a given vehicle in-game.

responsibilities: Sending direct messages to players with spawn codes

serverFeatures: Player identifier validation using license, steam, discord, or FiveM ID

sqlDatabaseLayer.purpose: Stores persistent vehicle ownership and metadata.

fields.imported_by: Staff member who imported the vehicle
fields.metadata: Mods, colours, liveries, and other optional vehicle properties

fiveMProcessing: Notify owner via DM with spawn code
vehicleImportDiscordToFiveM.ownerNotification: Vehicle Ownership Assigned — Spawn Code: gtr

ownershipEnforcementFiveMOnly.trigger: When a player enters a vehicle
ownershipEnforcementFiveMOnly.optionalMessage: You are not authorised to drive this vehicle.

viewingVehiclesDiscordPanel.botResponse: Display an interactive panel listing the player's vehicles

fiveMUpdate: DM new owner with ownership details
DM previous owner with transfer confirmation

notifications.newOwner: Vehicle Ownership Assigned — Spawn Code: gtr — Given by George

fiveMProcessing: Send DM notifications to both parties

keyFeatures: Support for custom vehicles, mods, and liveries

implementationNotes.recommendedDatabasePattern: Use a central vehicle table with JSON-based allowed_drivers and metadata fields for extensibility.
implementationNotes.recommendedSecurityPractice: Validate all incoming Discord and FiveM actions server-side before changing ownership data.
